description:
Money-denominated offset purchase: retire the maximum cheapest-first
    verified mass whose exact cost fits inside budget_minor (never overspends).
    Built for callers whose restoration obligation is a currency amount —
    e.g. a revenue share accrued in a ledger. Idempotent on purchase_id;
    dry_run=true previews without mutating.

budget_minor.description: Most to spend, in minor units (cents); never exceeded.
budget_minor.title: Budget Minor

buyer.description: Id of the party retiring credits.
buyer.title: Buyer

dry_run.description: Optional. Preview the fills and cost without retiring. Default false.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

purchase_id.description: Your id for the purchase; repeating it never retires twice.
purchase_id.title: Purchase Id

name: buy_offset_budget
title: Buy offset budget
